title: Wireless ML Data Hub Wireless Task
description: Schema for a wireless communications research task used to organize dataset discovery.

id.description: Stable immutable slug used for references and URLs.

category.description: ID from data/task-categories.yaml. Cross-file validation is performed by scripts/validate.py.

description.description: Short domain-level definition of the wireless task, independent of any particular ML method.

status.description: active: part of the current catalogue taxonomy; candidate: retained for later activation; deprecated: kept for compatibility.

related_tasks.description: Optional IDs of closely related but distinct wireless tasks.

notes.description: Curator note. Not intended to define the task.

comparison_fields.description: Optional task-page comparison columns. The generator uses a generic default when omitted.
